The three guards (a move, a known attacker, still standing) have no registry ids (request R8), so they are written as feasibility; they run first, in the original order, before the gate. They differ only if the knocker is on my side but I am no longer in the field array (not reachable: the faint dispatch runs while I am still on the field). The L1 grid never sets a same-side attacker, so test/tests/elite-redux/decomp/B17/gates.test.ts checks both directions with stand-ins (the old canApply, the refactor, the rebuild and a deliberately wrong gate), and mutual-destruction.test.ts runs the foe direction in a real battle. The ability also carries the ability-level flag bypassFaint (set in wireBernerdRosterAbility, not an attr), which belongs to the ability blueprint, not to this block. Users: Splash Damage (6025, attr 0) and Two-Chambered (6086, attr 2, next to the HitMultiplier archetype attrs of other batches); both use the default share. Suspected game bugs, NOT fixed: (1) for a move with variable or no listed power (power -1 or 0, for example a fixed-damage or weight move) the repeated hit gets power max(1, floor(-0.5)) = 1, an almost harmless 1-power copy that still counts as a splash; (2) the marker is turn memory per holder, so with a multi-hit move only the FIRST landed hit splashes, which may or may not be intended (Two-Chambered hits twice). No other oddity found.

blocks.label: Make my Star moves hit extra times
blocks.summary: While the game decides how many times my move hits, moves that count as Star moves get 1 extra strike(s). Example: 1 means they hit twice.
blocks.whenLabel: While the game decides how many times a move hits
examples: Make my Star moves hit twice
Lunar moves strike one extra time

blocks.label: Deal less damage with each hit of my Star moves
blocks.summary: While the game calculates damage I deal, each hit of a move that counts as a Star move does 0.7 times its damage. Example: 0.7 = 70% damage per hit.
blocks.whenLabel: While the game calculates damage I deal
examples: Each hit of my Star moves does 70% damage
Weaken the strikes of lunar moves to 0.7x

params.label: Damage multiplier per hit (0.7 = 70% damage)

conditions.lib: request R31 (the move is Star-based)

feasibility: The multiplier can only lower damage (up to 1): the base class refuses values above 1

blocks.label: Expose the Dark-type foes when I enter
blocks.summary: When I enter the battle, every Dark-type foe on the field is exposed, so Psychic moves can hit it as if it were not Dark (like Miracle Eye).
examples: Let Psychic moves hit Dark-type foes when I switch in
Cast Miracle Eye on every Dark foe on entry
feasibility: Only Dark-type foes are changed; every other foe is left alone
It reaches the foes on the field at the moment I enter; a Dark foe that enters later is not exposed
It never changes anything for a preview (a simulated entry)
